result:
PR #93 is open: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/93

Summary of what was built and verified:
- `ai-os-scripts/verify_7day_task_completion.py` — enumerates every task created in the live 7-day window (219 as of the run), resolves each task's real PR via `pr_url.txt`/log grep/`gh pr list` headRefName match (batched, one `gh pr list --state all` call per repo instead of per-task calls), checks real live PR state, falls back to real commit-ancestry (`git log origin/<default-branch> --grep=<task_id>`) or genuine checkpoint-terminal-state for code-less investigation tasks.
- It automatically (not via hardcoding) caught both known deceptive-completion cases by comparing the PR number named in a task's title against the PR it actually merged: task-20260726-081117 and task-20260726-115425 both show `real_verified_status: MERGED` but with a reason explicitly stating the PR named in their titles (#563) is still OPEN and unresolved.
- Result distribution: MERGED 109, NO_PR_FOUND 76, OPEN_NOT_DONE 18, INVESTIGATION_ONLY 16, with 4 malformed task dirs explicitly listed as omitted rather than silently dropped.
- Outputs (`.md`/`.json`) and the `MASTER_INDEX.yaml` registry entry are committed; all three success criteria (count-only, grep check, JSON validity) verified passing. Left unmerged per instructions.
